entries.heading: Illini West Chargers
entries.narrative: - Robert - He is from Illinois, Chicago area. Robert joined us in Season 20 and decided to make the team his own finishing 4-15. He set the biggest lopsided lost against Sandusky. He is active with many trades. We'll see if it pays off.

entries.heading: *Turkeyfoot Rams -
entries.narrative:
Jake -
He lived in North Carolina, and had never played fantasy football until joining the league. He played offensive line in high school and believes that is where a team is built from. Since FF doesn't have O-lines, TEs are the next best thing. He is the TE whisperer. He was shocked when a RB (Fred Taylor) was autopicked for him in the initial draft. Jake shares a record for Most Consecutive Wins at 13. He has several Awards with a MVP in season 16 for Josh Allen, 2 Offensive Rookies in Season 2 & 8 (Adrian Peterson, Le'Veon Bell) and 2 Defensive Rookies in Season 6 & 8 (Patrick Peterson, Kiko Alonso). Jake has won his division twice and owns a Championship. Jake passed away from a heart-attack February 2025. He was one to stir things up with other owners. Shit talker. He kept everyone entertained despite being a crayon eater.
